title: 1930s Shanghai Songstress
story_prompt: In a dimly lit 1930s Shanghai parlor, a glamorous songstress in a silk qipao stands near a glowing gramophone. The camera slowly pushes in as she turns her head, her eyes meeting the warm light. The atmosphere is elegant and nostalgic, with a hint of melancholy.
scene_prompts: A richly decorated 1930s Shanghai parlor with carved wooden furniture, velvet curtains, and a gramophone emitting a warm golden glow.
A glamorous songstress in a silk qipao, her hair styled in waves, stands beside the gramophone, her face half-lit by the warm light.
The camera slowly pushes in as she turns toward the gramophone, her eyes reflecting the glow, with dust motes dancing in the light.
video_prompt: Cinematic, 8-second shot of a glamorous 1930s Shanghai songstress in a silk qipao standing in a vintage parlor with carved wood and velvet. A gramophone glows warmly. The camera slowly pushes in as she turns her head toward the light, her face illuminated. Moody, elegant, nostalgic atmosphere. Realistic, smooth camera movement, 4K, film grain.
